xmldoc.short_description: Check an ISHNE file for the faults a reader cannot see.

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with ok (true when nothing is wrong) and issues (a cellstr of what is).

description.p: It checks the faults a reader cannot otherwise see: a missing magic, a file too short for its header, a lead count out of range, and a header whose stored CRC does not match the one computed over it. The CRC is the format's own guard against a header corrupted on disk, and this is the one place it is verified.
A stored checksum of zero is read as "none computed" and is not held against the file.
